hypothesis: H-LBDISTILL-NAIVE: treat every published raster as an independent rater and fuse them with Dawid-Skene log-odds
what_was_run: scripts/leaderboard_distill.py over 128 published rasters; per-rater sensitivity p_i from inverting the metric; posterior odds accumulated in log space; N and the prior truth rate fitted by leave-one-file-out

result.note: estimated scores above 1.0 are impossible; the grid optimum sits on the boundary (N=130k, pi=0.06)

why_it_failed: the top published rasters share 0.87-1.00 of their dots, so conditional independence is grossly violated; 15 near-duplicate raters multiply to near-certainty
what_was_kept: the per-rater sensitivity p_i = s_i(0.2 D_i + 0.8 N)/D_i, which is exact given the algebra and is reused by every later script
stopped_after: one configuration sweep; no submission slot used
